thread:
Maria: Heads-up — on the 8k seq canary we hit a transient OOM on prod-dedicated-03 during a high-kv-hit run. observed around 1:15 UTC.
Raj: What did the logs show? stacktrace or allocator msgs?
Maria: Allocator printed: \"OOM: requested 1.2GB for logits_scratchpad but only 512MB free in slab_pool\" + a couple of kv cache eviction warnings.
Noah: Did batching spikes coincide? looks like a 4x burst in concurrent requests between 1:14:50-1:15:10
Maria: Yep — concurrent inflight went 60->240 due to a routing misconfig (canary policy didn't apply the per-customer rate cap).
Elaine: Curious — why did tensor pool not hand back scratchpad memory? we expected eager-free on large idle slabs.
Raj: We're seeing fragmentation in the slab allocator: many ~64MB allocations for activation buffers + a few large 512MB allocations for logits. freelist had small pieces but not contiguous space for the large logits_scratchpad.
perf-bot: Profiling snapshot attached (summary):

```
timestamp 1965432100
allocations:
  activations: 64MiB x 18 (avg live 12)
  logits_scratchpad: 512MiB x 3
  kv_kv_cache: 128MiB x 8
slab_pool: 4GiB total, 1.2GiB free but scattered
peak_rss: 13.6GiB
```

Noah: So free bytes exist but fragmentation prevented a single 512MB allocation.
Maria: For a mitigation I flipped on eager-coalesce for the slab freer and forced a compact on low-load, which temporarily recovered capacity.
Raj: That explains why OOM cleared after ~30s. But we need a longer-term fix: either pre-size logits_scratchpad to use pooled smaller buffers + scatter-gather, or change kernel selection to use memory-light variant when contiguous allocation fails.
Elaine: Kernel fallback is interesting — we could detect allocation failure and pick a sequence-kernel that streams logits to temp pinned host memory (with small perf hit) rather than OOM.
Noah: But streaming to host for many concurrent requests will tank latency. I'd prefer improving reuse: switch logits to allocate as N x 64MiB fragments and then aggregate at write-time.
Raj: That requires changes in scratchpad API; current runtime assumes single contiguous logits buffer per request. We can add an indirection layer: a SmallVec of fragments + a compute path that accepts scattered outputs.
Maria: Proposal: implement fragment-backed logits buffers (config flag: runtime.logits.fragment_size=64MB) + allocator path that prefers fragments when contiguous big allocs fail. Start as opt-in.
Elaine: Also add a fast-path to compact slabs during quiet periods: schedule background compaction when concurrency < 20 and free_ratio > 0.2.
Noah: Agree. Add telemetry: metric for fragmentation_ratio = largest_free_chunk / total_free to alert when fragmentation crosses 0.4.
perf-bot: Regression note: this popped after kernel scheduler change 1963001120 that switched default to 'fast-kernel-v2' which uses larger temporary logits workspace to improve throughput.
Raj: So tradeoff: new kernel gives better throughput in low-fragmentation scenarios but increases risk of OOM under bursty concurrency. We should add kernel-selection policy: prefer fast-kernel-v2 only when fragmentation_ratio < 0.35 and expected_seq_len <= 4k.
Maria: Action items:
  - Raj: prototype fragment-backed logits allocator + compatibility shim (PR target: next week)
  - Elaine: implement background slab compactor + compaction telemetry (PR target: 2 weeks)
  - Noah: add alert + dashboard for fragmentation_ratio and concurrent inflight spikes (quick dashboard)
  - Maria: add kernel-selection heuristics in router (policy change + unit tests)

Raj: Quick sketch of allocator fallback logic:

```
if alloc(contiguous_size) fails:
  if config.logits.fragment_size:
    allocate fragments = ceil(size / fragment_size)
    return fragment_list
  else:
    raise OOM
```

Elaine: Also let's add a canary that forces fragmentation by preallocating holes (simulate) and run perf regression to ensure latency delta tolerable.
Noah: One more: KV cache behaviour — high kv-hit ratio increases allocation pressure since we pin a lot of KV shards. Maybe we should decay pinned shards more aggressively when fragmentation_ratio high.
Maria: Good call. Add a knob: kv.cache.pin_threshold which lowers pinning when fragmentation_ratio>0.4.
perf-bot: CI note — please mark the PRs with the label "alloc-reuse" and add perf regression baseline runs (stable-1 + fast-kernel-v2) before merging.
ci-bot: Run scheduled: nightly-canary after PR merge. Remember to include the stress test with bursty concurrency profile: 50->250 inflight in 30s.
Raj: Will post a draft PR for fragment allocator tomorrow. I'll include microbench results showing <6% p99 hit on small fragments vs previous contiguous baseline.
Maria: Thanks — keep me looped. If anyone finds an urgent regression, tag @oncall-eng-runtime.
Noah: 👍 I'll add the dashboard and a synthetic that reproduces the hole pattern.
Elaine: I'll start the compactor impl. plan to use deferred mutex-free merges to avoid latency spikes.
Maria: Great. Closing thread — let's reconvene after Raj's PR review. :thumbsup:
